description: Config-only DTDL v2 schema for the gpu MetricType. contents[] is empty by design -- describes the devicecfg.json Sensor surface, not a telemetry contract. schemas[] publishes the reusable Enums and the GpuSensorParameters Object consumed by config-rules.js.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'gpu'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. GPU sensors conventionally use 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema; must additionally match the Telemetry's native DTDL schema.
Reusable Object schema for the Parameters block of every gpu Sensor in devicecfg.json. GPU sensors take no type-specific extra parameters.

Reusable Object schema for the SensorInfo block of every Sensor in devicecfg.json. Models the wire-output metadata: declared schema, operator-facing display strings, and the read/write directionality contract.
schemas.comment: SIL2 read-only contract: every Sensor declared in devicecfg.json represents an agent-emitted reading. Consumers MUST set isReadable=true and isWritable=false; the agent rejects writes (WriteSensorDataAsync returns false) and commands (ExecuteCommandAsync returns CommandNotSupported) by design. A future writable GPIO-output extension would introduce its own MetricType with isWritable=true; existing read-direction MetricTypes never flip writability.

fields.name: schema
fields.description: On-the-wire JSON type the agent emits for this Sensor's Value (matches the per-MetricName schema documented in the *_FIELDS.md reference). The agent rejects startup if SensorInfo.Schema disagrees with the runtime type.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Long-form operator-facing description shown in dashboards and audit logs.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Short label for UI render (twin pages, alert subjects). Distinct from Sensor.Name, which is the wire identifier.

fields.name: isReadable
fields.description: True when the Sensor produces readings the agent forwards as telemetry. MUST be true for all sensors declared in this Interface (the agent is read-direction by design). Default: true.

fields.name: isWritable
fields.description: True when the Sensor accepts writes from the cloud. MUST be false for every sensor declared in this Interface; the agent rejects writes and commands per SIL2 fail-safe contract. Default: false.
